# GitHub Copilot Repository Instructions

## About this repository

This project is a simple student activity signup application.
- Backend: `src/app.py` (FastAPI)
- Frontend: `src/static/index.html`, `src/static/app.js`, and `src/static/styles.css`
- The app serves static frontend content and exposes API routes for activity lookup and signup.

## How to respond

- Keep suggestions short and focused.
- Use plain Python and vanilla JavaScript.
- Avoid introducing new frameworks or external dependencies unless clearly necessary.
- Prefer small, safe edits that improve validation, UX, or maintainability.
- When modifying code, mention the exact file names changed.
